Messages.Author: Xian
Messages.Body:
When retainers that require a discipline...let's say a Raptor for example :)
is transferred by Heidelberg/Shepherd's Innocence, does the retainer "forget"
who employed it and then use the new vampire's skill level, or does it
remember?

The appropriate ruling seemend to be:

A discipline-based card that is put into play is put into play at either basic
or superior level. Once in play, you can't change which level it was played
at, even if you give the vampire that played it a better ability. [TOM
19960403]

But I thought I remembered something about the whole "forgetting" thing.

Little help?

Xian

Messages.Author: Brian Reed
Messages.Body:
No, the retainer keeps all life, abilities, etc the same as when it was
originally recruited. Similarly, the raptor will not gain any abilities, if
it is transfered from a vamp w/ inferior animalism to a vampire w/ superior.
-Brian

Messages.Body:
Xian wrote:
>
> When retainers that require a discipline...let's say a Raptor for example :)
> is transferred by Heidelberg/Shepherd's Innocence, does the retainer "forget"
> who employed it and then use the new vampire's skill level, or does it
> remember?
>
> The appropriate ruling seemend to be:
>
> A discipline-based card that is put into play is put into play at either basic
> or superior level. Once in play, you can't change which level it was played
> at, even if you give the vampire that played it a better ability. [TOM
> 19960403]

Correct. The retainer's abilities/lives/etc. do not change when a new
minion takes control of him, nor when his controller gains/loses a
level of discipline.
